purpose: Field-level inventory for legacy terminology migration. This file does not change production data.
migration_policy: Current-facing fields migrate to current terminology.
Historical evidence stays unchanged or is explicitly marked historical/superseded.
Derived RAG/search projections should be regenerated after source governance rather than hand-edited when practical.
Compatibility paths and retrieval aliases are reviewed individually; old strings may be intentionally retained for discoverability.
No whole-file replacement of large registries from truncated connector output.
